mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.window_no AS windowNo, s.area, s.floor, (SELECT u.username FROM sys_user u WHERE u.stall_id = s.id AND u.role = 'MERCHANT' AND u.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS merchantUsername, (SELECT u.email FROM sys_user u WHERE u.stall_id = s.id AND u.role = 'MERCHANT' AND u.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS merchantEmail, (SELECT u.phone FROM sys_user u WHERE u.stall_id = s.id AND u.role = 'MERCHANT' AND u.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS merchantPhone, (SELECT u.avatar FROM sys_user u WHERE u.stall_id = s.id AND u.role = 'MERCHANT' AND u.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS merchantAvatar, s.location, s.category, s.manager_name AS managerName, s.manager_phone AS managerPhone, s.cover_image AS coverImage, s.description, s.hygiene_score AS hygieneScore, s.health_cert_url AS healthCertUrl, s.license_url AS licenseUrl, s.status, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS dishCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) AS avgRating, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS reviewCount, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS goodRate, IFNULL(fav.favoriteCount, 0) AS favoriteCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ds.quantity), 0) FROM dish_sales ds WHERE ds.stall_id = s.id) AS salesCount FROM canteen_stall s LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.stall_id = s.id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d2.stall_id AS stall_id, COUNT(*) AS favoriteCount FROM dish_favorite f INNER JOIN dish d2 ON f.dish_id = d2.id AND d2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d2.stall_id ) fav ON fav.stall_id = s.id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.id = #{id} GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.window_no, s.area, s.floor, s.location, s.category, s.manager_name, s.manager_phone, s.cover_image, s.description, s.hygiene_score, s.health_cert_url, s.license_url, s.status, fav.favoriteCount
